customer.business: ILLUSTRUS — site-uri și automatizări pentru consultanți în fonduri europene
customer.target: the owner of a small consulting firm in Romania (Bihor/Oradea or Bucharest) that writes and manages EU and national grant projects for SMEs and farmers; the income figure above is your FIRM's annual revenue in EUR, not your salary

segments.name: Solo consultant / PFA-style firm, 1-2 people, 5-15 clients a year
Small consulting firm, 3-8 people, 20-50 active clients
Established firm, 8-15 people, 50+ clients, several programmes

behaviours.name: Referral-only
behaviours.how: All clients come from recommendations; has never paid for marketing and doubts a website brings clients.

behaviours.name: Has a cheap site already
behaviours.how: Paid 300-500 EUR for a WordPress site years ago; it is outdated but 'works'.

behaviours.name: Drowning in admin
behaviours.how: Spends evenings chasing clients for documents and answering unqualified requests; would pay to get hours back.

behaviours.name: Price-anchored locally
behaviours.how: Knows that sites in Oradea cost 400-900 EUR and compares every quote to that.

behaviours.name: Tech-curious
behaviours.how: Uses ChatGPT, follows AI news, likes to be first; but wants proof it works.

behaviours.name: Skeptical of newcomers
behaviours.how: Burned once by an agency that disappeared; asks for portfolio, references and who will answer the phone in a year.

pitch:
ILLUSTRUS (Oradea / Bucharest) builds websites and automations for consultants in European funds.

PRO package: a professional website (6–8 pages, texts written from two interviews with you, FAQ written the way clients search, structured data, Google Business profile) plus two automations: (1) every request from your site is turned into a structured file, pre-checked for eligibility by AI with a stated reason, sent to you, and the client books a slot in your calendar automatically; (2) your clients receive a secure link to upload documents, you see what is missing, and reminders go out automatically.

Price: 2,400 EUR setup + 140 EUR/month (hosting, updates, daily backup, the automations' running costs, 4 hours of support a month), excluding VAT. Launch price for the first two clients: 1,920 EUR setup, in exchange for a named case study and two introductions. A smaller START package (site only) is 1,200 EUR + 60 EUR/month.

Terms: 50% at signing, 50% when the site matches the written specification; 90 days of free fixes; 12-month subscription, 30 days' notice; the site and content are yours. Delivered in 7 weeks, kickoff in person in Oradea or online.

What it does not promise: Google rankings, appearances in AI answers, or more clients. It promises fewer unqualified requests to handle by hand and less chasing of documents. The founder is a database developer by day and works on this 10–12 hours a week; support requests are answered within one working day.
